papers.title: TICToK: A comprehensive knowledgebase of tattoo ink chemicals and investigation of their associated toxicities and regulations
papers.translated_title: TICToK：一个全面的纹身墨水化学成分知识库及其相关毒性和法规研究
papers.author: Chivukula, N.
papers.summary: Tattoos and permanent make-up, involving dermal injection of chemicals, are increasingly popular, with 30-40% of young adults in North America and Europe having at least one tattoo. Recent studies have suggested a possible association between tattooing and health risks, including skin cancers and lymphomas, although no definitive link has yet been established. This study comprehensively catalogs tattoo ink chemicals and investigates their potential adverse effects, addressing the urgent need for greater understanding of tattoo-related health concerns. First, 364 unique tattoo chemicals were identified from various scientific and regulatory sources, with nearly half functioning as pigments. Hazardous chemicals were identified, revealing carcinogens, endocrine disruptors, neurotoxicants, and dermal toxicants. A regulatory analysis based on key EU regulations, including harmonised classifications under Classification, Labelling and Packaging (CLP) regulation, Restriction Entry 75 of the REACH regulation, Cosmetic Products Regulation (CPR), and SVHC candidate list, revealed existing regulatory coverage of tattoo ink chemicals. Curated chemical-disease associations highlighted that some tattoo chemicals are known to cause dermatitis. Further, diverse toxicological information, including experimental results from REACH dossiers, were integrated to construct stressor-AOP network linking 151 chemicals to 362 AOPs, revealing potential carcinogenic mechanisms associated with tattoo ink chemicals. A systems biology approach revealed potential immunomodulatory effects associated with these chemicals. Finally, all findings have been made available through the online database Tattoo Ink Chemicals and associated Toxicities Knowledgebase (TICToK; https://cb.imsc.res.in/tictok), which can support risk assessment and sustainable tattoo practices.
papers.translated_summary: 纹身和永久性化妆（涉及将化学物质注入真皮层）正日益流行，北美和欧洲30%-40%的年轻人至少有一个纹身。近期研究表明，纹身可能与健康风险（包括皮肤癌和淋巴瘤）存在关联，尽管尚未建立明确因果关系。本研究系统性地编录了纹身墨水中的化学物质，并探究其潜在不良效应，以应对当前对纹身相关健康问题认知不足的迫切需求。首先，从各类科学和监管来源中识别出364种独特的纹身化学物质，其中近半数作为颜料使用。通过鉴定有害化学物质，发现了致癌物、内分泌干扰物、神经毒物和皮肤毒物。基于欧盟关键法规（包括《分类、标签和包装法规》的统一分类、《REACH法规》第75条限制条款、《化妆品法规》及高关注物质候选清单）的监管分析显示，现有法规已覆盖部分纹身墨水化学物质。经整理的化学物质-疾病关联表明，部分纹身化学物质已知会引发皮炎。此外，整合了包括REACH档案实验结果在内的多样化毒理学信息，构建了应激源-不良结局通路网络，将151种化学物质与362条AOPs相关联，揭示了纹身墨水化学物质的潜在致癌机制。系统生物学方法揭示了这些化学物质可能引发的免疫调节效应。最后，所有发现已通过在线数据库Tattoo Ink Chemicals and associated Toxicities Knowledgebase（TICToK；https://cb.imsc.res.in/tictok）公开，可支持风险评估和可持续纹身实践。

papers.title: Optimizing Network-Level TMS-fMRI: Benchmarking the TMS-Compatible Sushi MR Setup
papers.translated_title: 优化网络级TMS-fMRI：对兼容TMS的Sushi MR装置进行基准测试
papers.author: Xiong, Y.
papers.summary: Concurrent TMS-fMRI can map how stimulation affects both the targeted cortex and connected brain-wide networks, but this requires MR receive hardware that allows TMS coil placement while preserving reliable whole-brain BOLD sensitivity. We developed and benchmarked a practical TMS-compatible 'Sushi' MR receive setup assembled from two flexible 18-channel body arrays. Across six experiments, we tested functional readout validity, signal quality, and active TMS-fMRI compatibility. Resting-state fMRI (n = 12) and verbal N-back task-fMRI (n = 8) were acquired with Sushi, a commercially available 2x7-channel Surface setup, and a standard 64-channel head/neck array. Functional similarity to the 64-channel reference was quantified with spatial overlap, and multi-echo combination (MEcomb) was tested as a post-acquisition signal optimization strategy. Sushi recovered subject-specific resting-state networks that more closely matched the 64-channel reference than Surface, with no significant difference from the 64-channel test-retest reference. For task-fMRI, MEcomb increased task-map similarity for Sushi, whereas setup comparisons within each pipeline were not significant. MEcomb also improved resting-state similarity and increased temporal signal-to-noise ratio (tSNR) across receive setups. In phantom measurements, TMS coil placement produced spatially graded tSNR reductions relative to the no-TMS-coil condition, strongest near the coil. In one participant, active interleaved single-pulse TMS-fMRI over two cortical sites showed no detectable pulse-locked image artifacts; whole-brain MEcomb tSNR during active TMS-fMRI was reduced by 2.6-6.9% relative to the no-coil/no-stimulation reference. Together, Sushi and MEcomb provide complementary hardware and processing tools for TMS-compatible whole-brain fMRI. This combination supports network-level functional readouts while preserving feasibility for active interleaved TMS-fMRI.
papers.translated_summary: 同步TMS-fMRI可绘制刺激如何影响目标皮层及全脑连接网络，但这需要MR接收硬件在保持可靠全脑BOLD敏感度的同时兼容TMS线圈放置。我们开发并验证了一套实用的TMS兼容型"Sushi"MR接收装置，由两个柔性18通道体部阵列组装而成。通过六项实验，我们测试了功能读出有效性、信号质量及主动TMS-fMRI兼容性。采用Sushi装置、商用2x7通道表面阵列及标准64通道头颈阵列分别采集静息态fMRI（n=12）和言语N-back任务fMRI（n=8）。通过空间重叠量化与64通道参考的功能相似性，并测试多回波组合（MEcomb）作为采集后信号优化策略。Sushi恢复的受试者特异性静息态网络比表面阵列更接近64通道参考，与64通道重测参考无显著差异。在任务fMRI中，MEcomb提高了Sushi的任务图相似性，而各处理流程内的装置比较均不显著。MEcomb还提升了所有接收装置的静息态相似性并增加了时间信噪比（tSNR）。体模测量显示，TMS线圈放置导致tSNR相对于无线圈条件呈空间梯度下降，线圈附近降幅最大。在一名受试者中，对两个皮层位点进行主动交错单脉冲TMS-fMRI时未检测到脉冲锁定图像伪影；主动TMS-fMRI期间全脑MEcomb tSNR较无线圈/无刺激参考降低2.6-6.9%。综合而言，Sushi与MEcomb为TMS兼容全脑fMRI提供了互补的硬件与处理工具。该组合在保持主动交错TMS-fMRI可行性的同时，支持网络级功能读出。

papers.title: Negligible incorporation of lipophilic dyes into bona fide small extracellular vesicles
papers.translated_title: 脂溶性染料几乎不会掺入真正的小细胞外囊泡中。
papers.author: Ji, Y.
papers.summary: Lipophilic dyes are widely used to track extracellular vesicles (EVs), yet their labeling efficiency toward bona fide small EVs (sEVs) remains poorly defined. Using a serum-free HEK293F system that produces endogenously fluorescent protein-tagged sEVs (sEVs-FPT) as an unambiguous reference while minimizing interference from dye-binding non-vesicular particles, we reassessed this efficiency with two orthogonal methods: nanoflow cytometry and fluorescence microscopy. PKH26, PKH67, and DiD labeled less than 0.5% of sEVs-FPT, regardless of vesicle heterogeneity. In vivo, dye-derived signals were far less abundant than tag-derived signals and failed to colocalize with them. Mechanistic evidence indicates that this failure stems from the inability of sEVs, as acellular structures, to actively internalize dye aggregates. These findings reveal a fundamental limitation of lipophilic dye-based EV tracking and underscore the need for orthogonally validated labeling strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 亲脂性染料被广泛用于追踪细胞外囊泡（EVs），但其对真正的小型细胞外囊泡（sEVs）的标记效率仍不明确。我们利用无血清HEK293F系统产生内源性荧光蛋白标记的sEVs（sEVs-FPT）作为明确参照，同时最大限度减少染料结合非囊泡颗粒的干扰，通过两种正交方法（纳米流式细胞术和荧光显微镜）重新评估了这一效率。PKH26、PKH67和DiD标记的sEVs-FPT比例不足0.5%，且不受囊泡异质性的影响。在体内，染料来源的信号远少于标签来源的信号，且两者未能共定位。机制证据表明，这种失败源于sEVs作为无细胞结构无法主动内化染料聚集体。这些发现揭示了基于亲脂性染料的EV追踪的根本局限性，并强调了需要正交验证的标记策略。

papers.title: An integrated resource for systems-level analysis of aging hallmarks and associated genes
papers.translated_title: 一个用于系统级分析衰老标志及相关基因的综合资源
papers.author: Tiwari, R.
papers.summary: Aging is a complex biological process involving progressive cellular dysfunction, tissue decline, and increased susceptibility to multiple chronic diseases. A systemic view of aging through its established hallmarks provides a structured framework to understand this complexity and drive therapeutic discovery. To this end, we present AgingHallmarksDB, an interactive web platform that enables systems-level analysis of hallmark-associated gene sets. Aging-related genes were first curated from seven established resources, and those present in at least two of these resources were considered as consensus aging-related genes. Using functional annotations derived from GO, KEGG, and Reactome, a total of 3111 genes were mapped to the 11 aging hallmarks, of which 2593 were supported by additional experimental or manually curated evidence, with 1089 of these forming the consensus set. Further, AgingHallmarksDB supplements hallmarks and gene annotations with tissue or cell-type class specificity, exosomal profiles, and regulatory interactions, enabling users to perform hallmark enrichment, protein-protein and regulatory interaction-based analysis. To elucidate the interconnectedness of hallmarks, network separation and proximity analyses of hallmark-associated modules were performed, revealing functional overlap between hallmarks on the human interactome. Furthermore, the utility of AgingHallmarksDB was demonstrated through network topological and regulatory interaction analyses of common hallmark genes, hallmark enrichment and network proximity analyses of eight chronic age-related diseases and seven developmental and congenital diseases, and gene set enrichment analysis of a PM2.5-associated skin transcriptome. Together, these analyses highlight the utility of AgingHallmarksDB for aging hallmark-centred systems biology research. The resource is accessible at https://cb.imsc.res.in/aginghallmarksdb/.
papers.translated_summary: 衰老是一个复杂的生物学过程，涉及进行性的细胞功能障碍、组织衰退以及对多种慢性疾病易感性的增加。通过其已确立的标志性特征对衰老进行系统性审视，为理解这种复杂性并推动治疗发现提供了结构化框架。为此，我们推出了AgingHallmarksDB，这是一个交互式网络平台，能够对标志性相关基因集进行系统级分析。首先从七个已建立的资源中筛选出衰老相关基因，其中出现在至少两个资源中的基因被视为共识性衰老相关基因。利用来自GO、KEGG和Reactome的功能注释，共有3111个基因被映射到11个衰老标志，其中2593个基因获得了额外的实验或人工整理证据支持，而1089个基因构成了共识集。此外，AgingHallmarksDB还补充了组织或细胞类型特异性、外泌体谱以及调控相互作用的标志和基因注释，使用户能够进行标志富集分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和基于调控相互作用的分析。为了阐明标志之间的相互关联性，我们对标志相关模块进行了网络分离和邻近性分析，揭示了人类相互作用组中标志之间的功能重叠。进一步地，通过常见标志基因的网络拓扑和调控相互作用分析、八种慢性年龄相关疾病及七种发育与先天性疾病标志富集和网络邻近性分析，以及PM2.5相关皮肤转录组的基因集富集分析，展示了AgingHallmarksDB的实用性。这些分析共同凸显了AgingHallmarksDB在以衰老标志为中心的系统生物学研究中的价值。该资源可通过https://cb.imsc.res.in/aginghallmarksdb/访问。

papers.title: deepthought: the microscopy acquisition stack as an object of study
papers.translated_title: 深度思考：将显微成像采集栈作为研究对象
papers.author: Kesavan, P. S.
papers.summary: Analysis-in-the-loop microscopy has been demonstrated many times, but it is rarely used outside the laboratories that build it. Each demonstration constructs its own acquisition infrastructure, so little transfers between them, and it has remained unclear which parts of the problem are already solved. In this work, the microscopy acquisition stack was itself treated as the object of study, and was investigated by construction. A minimal stack was built end to end, and four applications were then driven through it as test conditions. These were fixed-cell high-throughput immunofluorescence, live time-lapse imaging of an unsynchronized population, fluorescence anisotropy imaging, and autonomous focus and exposure. Each element of the stack was then classified by how it varied across these applications. Device access, sequencing, data storage and viewing held constant, and mature implementations of each were adopted unchanged. Interpretation, or how an image becomes a set of entities, differed with the application and belongs behind an interface. Two elements had nothing available to adopt and were therefore built. These are a geometric representation of the sample that a plan can traverse, and a representation of a run that yields detected objects rather than images. With those two in place, feedback from analysis into acquisition was ordinary control flow. The system was applied to the DNA damage response, where 22,000 cells were acquired and analyzed without operator intervention, and cells were followed through mitosis over 24 hours in an unsynchronized population without chemical synchronization. One element, targeting, or the choice of where to observe next, varies between applications and remains unabstracted in this implementation. It is identified here as the next requirement.
papers.translated_summary: 分析在环显微成像技术已被多次验证，但除构建该技术的实验室外鲜少应用。每次验证都需自建采集基础设施，导致技术成果难以迁移，且始终未能明确哪些问题已获解决。本研究将显微成像采集栈本身作为研究对象，通过构建方式进行探究。我们端到端构建了最小化采集栈，并驱动四个应用作为测试条件：固定细胞高通量免疫荧光、非同步化群体活细胞延时成像、荧光各向异性成像、以及自动对焦与曝光。随后对采集栈各元素在不同应用中的变化进行分类。设备访问、序列控制、数据存储与可视化保持恒定，并直接采用各环节成熟实现方案。而图像解析（即图像转化为实体集合的过程）因应用而异，需置于接口之后。有两个元素无可采用方案，因此自主构建：一是可供规划路径遍历的样本几何表征，二是能产出检测对象而非图像的运行表征。这两个元素就位后，分析结果反馈至采集过程即成为常规控制流。该系统应用于DNA损伤反应研究，在无操作员干预下完成22,000个细胞的采集与分析，并在无化学同步条件下追踪非同步化群体中细胞24小时的有丝分裂过程。靶向选择（即下一步观测位置的决策）因应用而异，在本实现中尚未抽象化，被确认为下一阶段需求。

papers.title: Occurrence of Biased mTOR Signaling in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
papers.translated_title: 肝细胞癌中偏向性mTOR信号的发生
papers.author: Singh, R.
papers.summary: Background: mTOR signaling promotes cell growth and anabolic processes in all eukaryotes. Hyperactivation of mTOR signaling is associated with various cancers along with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). HCC is a highly lethal malignancy with multiple aetiologies such as viral infection, alcohol abuse, and metabolic dysfunction. Therapeutic options for HCC remain limited due to an incomplete understanding of oncogenic drivers and poorly characterized mechanisms of disease progression. Methods: Various regimens of DEN and CCl4 carcinogen dosage were investigated on C57BL/6J mice to induce HCC. The histological analysis for fibrosis and serum markers for liver function were performed. Molecular analyses of oncogenic drivers were performed in the HCC tissues obtained from mice and HCC patients. The impact of inhibition of mTOR signaling was assessed on HCC progression. Results: We established a rapid DEN+CCl4 induced (DCI) HCC model in C57BL/6 mice to study disease progression longitudinally. The molecular analysis revealed upregulation of MAPK and downregulation of mTORC1-S6K-S6 signaling in HCC. However, other branches of mTOR such as mTORC1-ULK1, mTORC1-4EBP1, and mTORC2-PKC were upregulated due to the increased expression. Similar observations were found in tissues derived from HCC patients. Furthermore, inhibition of mTORC1 alone by Rapamycin did not reduce HCC progression but Torin 1 mediated inhibition of both mTORC1 and mTORC2 significantly reduced HCC progression. Conclusions: We propose this biased mTOR signaling modulates mTOR activity towards specific downstream processes that are crucial for cancer cell growth and targeting both the mTOR complexes has better therapeutic potential in HCC.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：mTOR信号通路在所有真核生物中促进细胞生长和合成代谢过程。mTOR信号过度激活与多种癌症及肝细胞癌（HCC）相关。HCC是一种高度致命的恶性肿瘤，病因多样，包括病毒感染、酒精滥用和代谢功能障碍。由于对致癌驱动因素了解不足以及疾病进展机制尚未明确，HCC的治疗选择仍然有限。方法：在C57BL/6J小鼠中研究不同剂量的DEN和CCl4致癌物方案以诱导HCC。进行纤维化组织学分析和肝功能血清标志物检测。对小鼠和HCC患者获得的HCC组织进行致癌驱动因子的分子分析。评估抑制mTOR信号对HCC进展的影响。结果：我们在C57BL/6小鼠中建立了一种快速DEN+CCl4诱导（DCI）的HCC模型，用于纵向研究疾病进展。分子分析显示HCC中MAPK上调，mTORC1-S6K-S6信号下调。然而，由于表达增加，mTOR的其他分支如mTORC1-ULK1、mTORC1-4EBP1和mTORC2-PKC被上调。在HCC患者来源的组织中也观察到类似结果。此外，单独使用Rapamycin抑制mTORC1并未减少HCC进展，但Torin 1介导的mTORC1和mTORC2双重抑制显著减少了HCC进展。结论：我们提出这种偏向性mTOR信号将mTOR活性调节至对癌细胞生长至关重要的特定下游过程，靶向两种mTOR复合物在HCC中具有更好的治疗潜力。

papers.title: Falls Induced by Optogenetic Inhibition of Basal Forebrain Cholinergic Projections after Dorsomedial Striatal Dopamine Depletion in a Dual Disruption Model of Falling Vulnerability in Parkinson Disease
papers.translated_title: 在帕金森病跌倒易感性的双重干扰模型中，背内侧纹状体多巴胺耗竭后基底前脑胆碱能投射的光遗传抑制诱发的跌倒
papers.author: Kucinski, A.
papers.summary: Falls are a common and debilitating feature of Parkinson's Disease (PD) patients. Prefrontal acetylcholine (ACh) deficits, as well as nigrostriatal dopamine deficits, are implicated in vulnerability to falls. PD patients with loss of cortical ACh and associated cognitive dysfunction experience a higher rate of falls than PD patients without cortical ACh loss. In addition, chemogenetic inhibition of basal forebrain (BF) neurons in rats increases the vulnerability to falls on a balance beam task. Here, the impact of transient optogenetic inhibition specifically of BF cholinergic neurons was assessed in rats with dorsomedial striatal dopamine lesions during traversal of straight or zig-zag balance beams using the Michigan Complex Movement Control Task (MCMCT). Adding transient optogenetic inhibition of BF cholinergic neurons with striatal dopamine lesions elevated falls above the level produced by striatal dopamine lesions or BF ACh inhibition alone, especially on the challenging zig-zag task. These results support the critical role of BF-cortical cholinergic circuits in alleviating vulnerability to falls in PD patients with striatal dopamine loss, suggesting that it is combined loss of BF cholinergic activity and striatal dopamine that leads to greatest vulnerability to falls and related complex movement impairments.
papers.translated_summary: 跌倒是一种常见且严重影响帕金森病（PD）患者生活质量的症状。前额叶乙酰胆碱（ACh）缺乏以及黑质纹状体多巴胺缺乏均与跌倒易感性相关。伴有皮质ACh缺失及认知功能障碍的PD患者，其跌倒发生率高于无皮质ACh缺失的PD患者。此外，通过化学遗传学抑制大鼠基底前脑（BF）神经元，会增加其在平衡木任务中的跌倒易感性。本研究采用密歇根复杂运动控制任务（MCMCT），评估了在背内侧纹状体多巴胺损伤大鼠中，短暂光遗传学特异性抑制BF胆碱能神经元对其在直线或Z形平衡木上行走的影响。在纹状体多巴胺损伤基础上叠加短暂光遗传学抑制BF胆碱能神经元，使跌倒发生率显著高于单独纹状体多巴胺损伤或单独BF ACh抑制组，尤其在具有挑战性的Z形平衡木任务中表现更为明显。这些结果支持BF-皮质胆碱能通路在缓解纹状体多巴胺缺失PD患者跌倒易感性中的关键作用，提示BF胆碱能活性与纹状体多巴胺的联合缺失是导致最高跌倒易感性及相关复杂运动障碍的根本原因。

papers.title: Numerosity adaptation reflects multiple levels of sensory processing
papers.translated_title: 数量适应反映了多个层次的感官处理过程。
papers.author: Takahashi, T. J.
papers.summary: Psychophysical and neuroimaging studies have repeatedly suggested that perceived numerosity is susceptible to adaptation, involving high-level number representations. However, whether adaptation to low-level visual features contributes to numerosity adaptation remains unclear. Here, we provide evidence that numerosity adaptation involves not only high- but also low-level visual processing stages. Through a series of psychophysical experiments, we found that the effect of numerosity adaptation was significantly reduced, but not eliminated, when the contrast polarity of stimuli was inverted relative to the preceding adaptor. Follow-up experiments confirmed that the persistence of the aftereffects was not due to retinal adaptation or top-down decision bias. Finally, a computational model incorporating both high- and low-level adaptation successfully reproduced the behavioral pattern. These findings suggest that numerosity adaptation involves at least two stages of visual processing: adaptation to low-level visual features at early sensory stages and to numerosity at higher levels of the visual processing hierarchy.
papers.translated_summary: 心理物理学和神经影像学研究反复表明，感知数量易受适应效应影响，涉及高级数字表征。然而，低层视觉特征的适应是否参与数量适应仍不明确。本研究通过系列心理物理实验发现，当刺激对比极性相对于前序适应刺激发生反转时，数量适应效应显著减弱但未完全消除。后续实验证实后效的持续性并非源于视网膜适应或自上而下的决策偏差。最终，整合高低层级适应机制的计算模型成功复现了行为模式。这些发现表明数量适应至少包含两个视觉处理阶段：早期感觉阶段对低层视觉特征的适应，以及视觉处理层级更高阶段对数量的适应。

papers.title: EEG-based classification models reveal differential neural processing of words and images
papers.translated_title: 基于脑电图的分类模型揭示了词汇与图像在神经处理上的差异。
papers.author: Morakabati, N. R.
papers.summary: Background: Machine learning methods employing neuroimaging data are useful for monitoring the activation of neural representations. Specifically, they can be used to discern the brain networks engaged in processing specific categories of items. This approach has been employed on neuroimaging data, including functional magnetic resonance imaging data and electroencephalography (EEG) data. New method: Here, we present a task and an analytical pipeline for investigating category representations using EEG. Participants (N = 30) viewed a series of images and words of objects belonging to five categories (Animals, Tools, Food, Scenes, and Vehicles) and responded when items from the same category were presented consecutively. Results: We trained support vector machines on EEG data within participants and found that both image trials and word trials yielded significant category classification accuracy, with image trials achieving higher accuracy than word trials. When comparing categories in a pair-wise fashion, all pairs were statistically distinguishable for image trials, whereas only one pair was distinguishable for word trials. Parietal and Left Temporal electrodes contributed more to image classification than Frontal and Right Temporal electrodes. Category-specific activity patterns also generalized across participants for image trials. Comparison with existing methods: Our data and analytic pipeline yielded high classification accuracies, primarily for image trials, providing support for the utility of EEG data for neural decoding. Conclusions: These methods can be instrumental for exploring the activation and reactivation of neural representations at the category level during wakefulness and, potentially, during offline states.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：利用神经影像数据的机器学习方法有助于监测神经表征的激活状态。具体而言，这些方法可用于识别处理特定类别项目时参与的大脑网络。该技术已被应用于功能磁共振成像和脑电图等神经影像数据。新方法：本研究提出了一项任务及分析流程，用于通过脑电图探究类别表征。30名参与者观看分属五个类别（动物、工具、食物、场景和交通工具）的物体图像和词语，并在连续呈现同一类别项目时做出反应。结果：我们在参与者个体内对脑电图数据训练支持向量机，发现图像试次和词语试次均产生显著的类别分类准确率，其中图像试次的准确率高于词语试次。在成对比较类别时，图像试次中所有类别对均可被统计区分，而词语试次仅有一对可区分。顶叶和左颞叶电极对图像分类的贡献大于额叶和右颞叶电极。图像试次的类别特异性活动模式在参与者间具有泛化性。与现有方法比较：我们的数据和分析流程主要针对图像试次取得了高分类准确率，验证了脑电图数据在神经解码中的实用性。结论：这些方法有助于探索清醒状态下（以及潜在离线状态下）类别层面神经表征的激活与再激活过程。

papers.title: Longitudinal Subject Pairing in Cross-Sectional Neonatal Data Reveals Asynchronous Structural and Functional Brain Maturation
papers.translated_title: 纵向受试者配对在横断面新生儿数据中揭示了结构和功能脑成熟的不同步性
papers.author: Namiranian, R.
papers.summary: The asynchronous development of structural and functional brain networks in early childhood remains largely unexamined, primarily due to the scarcity of longitudinal neuroimaging data. Resolving this temporal dimension is critical, as it promises to reshape our understanding of structural-functional (S-F) coupling, revealing not only whether brain architecture supports function, but also when and over what timescale its influence emerges. However, while rapid neonatal brain maturation and logistical constraints continue to hinder longitudinal data collection, large-scale cross-sectional multimodal datasets are currently available to bridge this gap. Here, we propose a longitudinal subject-pairing framework that reconstructs developmental trajectories from cross-sectional data. It pairs the infants with a predefined age gap while maximizing their similarity in both structural and functional features, thereby approximating the longitudinal trajectory of functional changes in relation to structural maturation. As a case study, we applied this framework to the perisylvian region in a subset of 505 neonates from the multimodal dHCP brain dataset. The myelination index was derived as a structural feature from MRI, and the fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) was derived as a functional feature from resting-state functional MRI. A conventional cross-sectional analysis revealed a moderate S-F correlation magnitude (r = 0.34). In contrast, the proposed framework demonstrated a significant increase in S-F coupling to r = 0.46 when the structural maturation precedes functional maturation by approximately five days. These findings provide novel evidence of a functional maturation lag relative to structural brain development in neonates. Beyond elucidating S-F relationships in the early developing brain, this work establishes a framework for future longitudinal studies and advances in brain modeling across developmental trajectories, aging, and disease prediction.
papers.translated_summary: 婴幼儿早期脑结构与功能网络的异步发育尚未得到充分研究，主要受限于纵向神经影像数据的匮乏。解析这一时间维度至关重要，因为它有望重塑我们对结构-功能耦合的理解，不仅揭示脑结构是否支撑功能，更阐明其影响在何时、以何种时间尺度显现。然而，新生儿期脑快速成熟及后勤限制持续阻碍纵向数据采集，目前可获取的大规模横断面多模态数据集为弥补这一缺口提供了可能。本文提出一种纵向受试者配对框架，通过横断面数据重建发育轨迹。该框架将具有预设年龄差的婴儿配对，同时最大化其结构与功能特征的相似性，从而近似模拟功能变化相对于结构成熟的纵向轨迹。作为案例研究，我们将该框架应用于多模态dHCP脑数据集中505名新生儿的侧裂周围区域。从MRI中提取髓鞘化指数作为结构特征，从静息态功能MRI中提取低频波动分数振幅（fALFF）作为功能特征。传统横断面分析显示中等程度的结构-功能相关（r=0.34）。相比之下，当结构成熟先于功能成熟约五天时，本框架显示结构-功能耦合显著增强至r=0.46。这些发现为新生儿脑功能成熟滞后于结构发育提供了新证据。本研究不仅阐明了早期发育脑中的结构-功能关系，更为未来纵向研究及跨发育轨迹、衰老和疾病预测的脑建模进展建立了框架。
